evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The suite is granted authority to assign a role (reviewer) to a person by virtue of an action — a rule-based allocation that enacts authority-ranking.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: Framing the memory as a vehicle for the enrollment rule reinforces the same authority-ranking enactment — the assertion's governance function is the memory's purpose.

mints.name: AutomatedRoleAssignment
mints.title: a system enrolls an actor into a role as an automatic consequence of an action
mints.frame: Does the expression enact authority by making a role assignment flow automatically from a performed action, without human intermediation?
